info.title: API.SH: Manor
info.description: The Manor API from API.SH: public Manor data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Live online stock for every size of the article's colour (article id, size, in stock, pieces left, status, price, previous price, restock dates), or for every colour with all_colors=true.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A manor.ch product link (https://www.manor.ch/de/p/10003633410) or its article id (each size and colour is its own article: 11 digits, or a partner code such as mp-23654683-tproduct). `url` is accepted as the same thing.

parameters.name: ean
parameters.description: Look the article up by its EAN/GTIN instead of `id`.

parameters.name: all_colors
parameters.description: true: every colour of the style, each with its sizes.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default, or the link's), fr or it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every brand Manor sells with its number of products and the id `brand=` takes; optional name filter.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-brands

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only brands whose name contains this text.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default, or the link's), fr or it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The store's full category menu (departments and every level below), each entry with its name, link, category code (for /manor/v1/category) or brand id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-categories

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default, or the link's), fr or it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of a Manor category or brand page, with the same product fields, filters, sorts and paging as search. Give a category code (from /manor/v1/categories), or a manor.ch category link (.../c/<code>, filters in the link are kept) or brand link (.../b/<brand>/...).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category code such as woman-coat, or a manor.ch category or brand link (`url` is accepted as the same thing).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default, or the link's), fr or it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, top_rated, discount, top_seller, newest.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand filter, comma = any of (names or ids from /manor/v1/brands, e.g. levis, tommy-hilfiger).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour filter by the site's colour names (Schwarz, Blau ... in the chosen language; values in `facets`), comma = any of.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter by the size names in `facets` (XS, M, 38 ...), comma = any of.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in CHF.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in CHF.

parameters.name: discount_min
parameters.description: Only products reduced by at least this percentage.

parameters.name: shipped_by_manor
parameters.description: true: only products shipped by Manor itself (no partner sellers).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other filter the site offers, as <facet id>:<value>|<value> (repeatable), with ids and values from `facets`, e.g. 60001243:60001243-70000000 for a fit.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-200 (default 48).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Manor article: brand, name, product type, EAN, price, previous price and recommended price (amount, ISO currency CHF, label), discount, unit price, the selected colour and size with their article ids, every size of the colour with its own article id, price and online stock (in stock, pieces left, restock dates), every colour with its article id and hex code, partner offers (seller, price, shipping, pieces, delivery dates), description, features (material, fit, care ...), documents such as the size guide, images, breadcrumbs, labels, energy label and store pickup availability. `raw` has the site's full record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A manor.ch product link (https://www.manor.ch/de/p/10003633410) or its article id (each size and colour is its own article: 11 digits, or a partner code such as mp-23654683-tproduct). `url` is accepted as the same thing.

parameters.name: ean
parameters.description: Look the article up by its EAN/GTIN instead of `id`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default, or the link's), fr or it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of an article as its product page shows them: average rating, review count, recommendation count and rating distribution, then each review with rating, title, text, date, the reviewer's nickname, language, helpful votes, verified purchase, photos and the brand's replies. Page with `page` (`next_page`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A manor.ch product link (https://www.manor.ch/de/p/10003633410) or its article id (each size and colour is its own article: 11 digits, or a partner code such as mp-23654683-tproduct). `url` is accepted as the same thing.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, highest, lowest, helpful, relevance.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

parameters.description: Only reviews written in this language (de, fr, it, en ...).

parameters.description: Page number (1-based).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-100 (default 10).

parameters.name: language

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the whole Manor store (fashion, beauty, home, toys, electronics, wine and the partner marketplace) in German, French or Italian: every product with its article id, style id, brand, name, price, previous price and recommended price (amount, ISO currency CHF), discount, colour, size, the other colours with their article ids, online stock (in stock, pieces left), rating, image, categories and EAN, plus the site's filters with counts (`facets`). The site's sorts and every filter it offers (brand, colour, size, price, discount, shipped by Manor, and any other facet). Page with `cursor` (`next_cursor`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manor-search

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products to return, 1-20 (default 5).

parameters.name: language

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
